name: Jehoiada
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: To Shemaiah the Nehelamite: because he sent letters in his own name to all the people at Jerusalem and to Zephaniah the priest, claiming the Lord had made Zephaniah priest in the stead of Jehoiada to put every man that makes himself a prophet in prison and the stocks, and asking why he had not reproved Jeremiah for telling the captives their captivity was long and to build houses.

note.label: Jeremiah 29: The Letter to the Captives
